Package neqsim.process.equipment.reservoir

Class InflowControlCompletion

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.reservoir.InflowControlCompletion
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class InflowControlCompletion extends Object implements Serializable
Multi-zone well completion with inflow control devices, for screening how an ICD, AICD, AICV or DAR changes the produced oil, water and gas.

Each zone has a linear productivity index on the in-situ total flow and a fixed in-situ phase split (water and gas volume fractions). The zones share one drawdown between the reservoir and the tubing. A device in series with a zone takes a share of that drawdown that grows with the flow and, for an AICD, AICV or DAR, with the water or gas fraction of the zone. The flow of each zone solves q / PI + dP_device(q) = drawdown.

The key screening output is compareAtSameOil(double, double): the device is given the extra drawdown that restores the oil rate of the bare completion, and the water and gas reductions at that oil rate are reported. The phase split of a zone is an input and does not change with drawdown (no coning, no relative-permeability feedback), so the result is an upper bound of the benefit for a zone whose water or gas comes from drawdown-driven coning.
